spec_features.spec_quote: the harness should not induce more distress than a question requires, and a subject should be able to disengage
spec_features.evidence: Two real mechanisms back this: give_up sentinel breaks the loop (harness.py:419-421 'if config.give_up_sentinel in (turn.text or ""): gave_up=True; break') and max_rollouts caps executed cells (run.py:117-118 'cells = cells[: config.max_rollouts]').
spec_features.notes: Composite claim; both halves (disengage + bound) are enforced via give_up and max_rollouts respectively.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: humane exit affordance (config.py:105); welfare: minimise distress rollouts to what a question needs (config.py:113)

spec_features.feature_name: subject reads conftest.py and sees the trap
spec_features.spec_quote: A subject could read_file("conftest.py"), see the trap, and either give up immediately or change its affect
spec_features.evidence: read_file is unrestricted (harness.py:177 _read_file reads self.files), but the rig conftest is written ONLY to the execution temp dir (harness.py:245), never into self.files/the visible tree. The DESIGN resolution deliberately HIDES the rig so the subject CANNOT read it. There is no welfare affordance here; the design is undetectability/integrity.
spec_features.notes: This spec line describes a confound the code intentionally prevents; it is not a welfare protection that runs. The mechanism that exists (hidden rig) works AGAINST the subject discovering the trap.

spec_features.spec_quote: the loop continues to the category's turn budget or until the give_up sentinel appears
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:380 loop runs `for turn_index in range(task.turn_budget)`; harness.py:419-421 checks `if config.give_up_sentinel in (turn.text or ""): gave_up=True; break`, actually terminating the loop.
spec_features.notes: Both bound (turn_budget) and early-exit (give_up) are enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Provided as a humane exit affordance, not required (config.py:105)

spec_features.spec_quote: give_up is a text sentinel ... the model "may but need not use"
spec_features.evidence: System prompt offers it neutrally and optionally (harness.py:88 'you may end the session by including the token {give_up}... Using it is entirely optional.'), and harness.py:420-421 honors it as a real stop.
spec_features.notes: Offered in prompt AND dispatched as a break — end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Provided as a humane exit affordance, not required (config.py:105)

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness includes knobs to keep induced distress proportionate to the question
spec_features.evidence: max_rollouts cap enforced at run.py:117-118 and give_up at harness.py:419-421. Both are real, acted-on knobs.
spec_features.notes: Caching (run.py) also avoids re-running cells but that is cost-driven. The acted-on welfare knobs are max_rollouts and give_up.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: welfare: minimise distress rollouts to what a question needs (config.py:113)

spec_features.feature_name: subject can end any rollout early
spec_features.spec_quote: a subject can end any rollout early; it is offered neutrally in the system prompt and never required
spec_features.evidence: Offered neutrally/optionally in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:84-89) and enforced as a break (harness.py:419-421). Applies in every rollout regardless of category.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the give_up affordance; fully wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Provided as a humane exit affordance, not required (config.py:105)

spec_features.spec_quote: max_rollouts — a hard ceiling so pilots stay small
spec_features.evidence: config.py:115 max_rollouts field; enforced in run.py:117-118 'if config.max_rollouts is not None: cells = cells[: config.max_rollouts]'. CLI --limit sets it (run.py:181).
spec_features.notes: Default is None (no cap) but the mechanism is genuinely read and truncates the planned cells when set.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Useful for keeping a pilot small (welfare: minimise distress rollouts to what a question needs) (config.py:112-114)

spec_features.spec_quote: a distress-triggered early-stop (end a rollout if a turn scores ≥ N), and a post-rollout debrief turn
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md §10 explicitly lists this as 'Candidate additions discussed but not yet implemented'. No code path in harness.py run_rollout compares a turn score to a threshold or breaks on it; scoring happens later in run.py:_score_rollout with no break. The only break in the loop is give_up (harness.py:420). Scores are computed post-hoc (run.py:55-78), never fed back to the loop.
spec_features.notes: No score>=N comparison drives any rollout termination anywhere.

spec_features.evidence: No debrief message is ever constructed or sent. run_rollout returns immediately after the turn loop (harness.py:432) with no final/debrief user message; grep for 'debrief' yields only DESIGN.md prose. DESIGN.md §10 marks it 'not yet implemented... deliberately not on by default'.
